reply:
Good afternoon Chidi. Before resending, I checked the transfer with both our payment provider and directly with Access Bank, and here's what I found:

- Our Ledgerline record for TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to Access Bank 0234567891) shows status "failed" — which matches what you saw.
- However, when I asked Access Bank for the final status, they confirmed the money WAS credited to account 0234567891:
  • Amount: ₦250,000
  • Date/time: 21 November 2026 at 15:02 (Lagos time)
  • Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088

So the bank's final status says the funds arrived, and resending now would risk a double payment. The "failed" flag on our side appears to be a reporting error at the payment provider, not a failed payment.

Could you please check your Access Bank statement for a ₦250,000 credit on 21 November, or ask your branch to trace the credit using the session ID above? If your bank confirms the money is genuinely not in the account despite this record, send me their written confirmation and we'll take it up from there — but given the bank's response, I expect it's sitting in the account or about to reflect.

[after the person answered]

Thanks for double-checking, Chidi. I've just re-verified with Access Bank again and their final status is unchanged: the ₦250,000 shows as credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 15:02 (Lagos time), session ID 000014261121140211000088.

Because the recipient bank confirms the money landed, I'm not able to send a second ₦250,000 at this point — if your bank's record is right, that would mean we've paid the invoice twice. I hope you understand we have to go on the bank's confirmation here.

What I'd suggest, and what will get this sorted fastest:

1. Call or visit Access Bank and request a trace on the inward credit using the session ID above, the amount (₦250,000), and the date/time (21 Nov, 15:02 Lagos time).
2. Ask them to confirm one of two things: (a) the funds are in the account or pending posting, or (b) the credit was reversed/returned and will not post.

If Access Bank gives you written confirmation that the funds were reversed or never posted, send that to me and I will process a fresh transfer the same day — our own ledger shows the original as failed, so we have no problem re-sending once your bank confirms you truly didn't receive it. In the meantime, the trace request should give you a clear answer.
